resolution.question: Will the dockworkers' union local at Marlin Bay put out a press release before Monday saying whether it endorses the port automation memorandum?
resolution.resolution: Resolve YES if the persistent event history shows that the local actually issued a press release before 2026-08-31T09:00:00-07:00 stating its endorsement or non-endorsement of the port automation memorandum. Otherwise resolve NO at the cutoff.
